coding.description: Architecture, supervision, and delivery; direct work or delegation by judgment

models.guidance: Preferred main coding model and the pr-reviewer and tech-lead default, via the Subs gateway. For Codex models, prefer subs-codex/<model-id>; if unavailable, preflight the same model through openai-codex/<model-id> before changing models. Direct Codex must be authenticated and available; the routes may share account limits. Explicit user provider/model selection wins and must not be silently redirected. Report the exact provider/model and fallback reason, inspect partial work, and use a later explicit pi-subagents launch; provider availability/auth/quota failures may justify another route, but unrelated launch/tooling/workflow failures remain infrastructure blockers under pi-subagents recovery rules. Tech-lead fallback: direct openai-codex/gpt-6-astra, then Fable, then public-only Muse, then GLM 5.3. Both Astra routes satisfy the same model slot, never two independent model opinions. The PR skill requests independent opinions from both Astra and anthropic/claude-fable-5-1 on the same patch and criteria when available; outside that skill, Fable remains an explicit per-launch review alternative. Use tech-lead for frontier judgment checkpoints (architecture, difficult tradeoffs, contested decisions) so a cheap main session consults frontier only at high-stakes moments. Reserve for architecture, difficult reasoning, supervision, and final judgment rather than routine implementation. Main-model selection remains independent of identity activation.

Configured default for ui-design in either public or private repositories: design direction, interaction specifications, and implementation guidelines, not routine UI implementation. UI implementation belongs to general using the GLM/Muse visibility routing and following accepted design guidelines. For the PR skill, select it with an explicit per-launch override for a second independent opinion alongside Astra on the same patch and criteria when available. Outside that skill, it remains an alternative to Astra for reviews.

Default for implementation (including UI implementation) and explore-codebase in verified public repositories; explicitly select Muse for these launches. For UI implementation, follow accepted design guidelines. Verify the actual repository is public and the handoff contains no private material before using Muse by default; a remote URL alone is not evidence of public visibility. Never send private or unknown-visibility repository context to Muse by default. An explicit user instruction to use Muse overrides this default routing regardless of repository visibility; confirm the requested scope and proceed with the user's choice.

Default for implementation (including UI implementation) in private or unknown-visibility repositories. Also the configured default for general. For UI implementation, follow accepted design guidelines. An explicit user instruction to use another model overrides this default regardless of repository visibility.

Configured default for explore-codebase in private or unknown-visibility repositories, and for web-researcher regardless of repository visibility. For explore-codebase in verified public repositories, explicitly select Muse instead. An explicit user instruction to use Muse overrides visibility routing.
